draft.heroMessage: Experienced Local Broker Serving Silver Valley & North Idaho
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome to Cindy Carlson Realty! We are passionate about helping you navigate the North Idaho real estate market, whether you’re seeking a mountain retreat, investment property, or your next family home.
draft.tagline: Rooted in Community, Dedicated to Your Success
draft.aboutParagraph: With over 18 years’ experience in North Idaho real estate and more than four decades living in the Silver Valley, Cindy Carlson combines deep local roots with unmatched professionalism. She’s built her business on a foundation of integrity, client advocacy, and ongoing education, earning multiple REALTOR® designations and leadership roles within the community. Cindy and her team understand the distinct character of the Silver Valley and are committed to providing personal, attentive service from first meeting to closing—and beyond.
draft.conciergeLine: Have questions about living in the Silver Valley? Reach out for genuine local insight and personal guidance.
draft.contactLine: Ready to make your move? Call Cindy Carlson directly at (208) 512-0078 or email cindy@cindycarlsonrealty.com for expert real estate advice.
draft.tone: Welcoming, knowledgeable, rooted in the local community, and service-focused

The Silver Valley is also famous for it’s Ski Resorts ~ Silver Mountain and Lookout Pass; it’s Bike Trails, ATV Trails and The World’s Longest Gondola. The narrow valley, about 40 miles in length, comprises a number of small towns along the South Fork of the Coeur d’Alene River and Interstate 90.

THE AREA
North Idaho’s Silver Valley
Nestled in the foothills of the Rocky Mountains, in the heart of the Panhandle National Forest, the Silver Valley is most noted for its mining heritage, dating back to the 1880s. The Silver Valley is also famous for it’s Ski Resorts ~ Silver Mountain and Lookout Pass; it’s Bike Trails, ATV Trails and The World’s Longest Gondola. The narrow valley, about 40 miles in length, comprises a number of small towns along the South Fork of the Coeur d’Alene River and Interstate 90.
ABOUT
Cindy Carlson, Broker, Realtor ® , ABR, CRS, GRI, RSPS, RPAC Major Investor
Cindy Carlson, Broker/owner of Cindy Carlson Realty, located in Kellogg, Idaho, is a 18 year residential/commercial real estate veteran. With deep roots to this area, Cindy and her husband Denny, have raised their family and enjoyed this scenic area for over 40 years. After 25+ years as a well known figure at a local dentist office, she decided to take her personal skills and stellar work ethic and turn it into a real estate career.
